relations.subject: Kenjiu Kasawara
relations.evidence: from 1880 on we pursued together the study of Sanskrit under Professor Max Miiller

relations.subject: Bunyiu Nanjio
relations.evidence: He was quite sympathetic and urged me to come to Oxford at once. Thus encouraged I made up my mind to settle there.

relations.subject: Bunyiu Nanjio
relations.evidence: I was helped in my study by Professor Macdonell who was then still a student at Oxford.

relations.subject: Bunyiu Nanjio
relations.evidence: In October, Kasawara joined me and from 1880 on we pursued together the study of Sanskrit under Professor Max Miiller

relations.subject: Bunyiu Nanjio
relations.role: collation of Chinese translations with Sanskrit text
relations.evidence: Mr Zengi Koyasu while in Tokyo made a thorough collation of the three Chinese translations with the Sanskrit text, and corrections were entered. He read the whole text with me.

relations.subject: Bunyiu Nanjio
relations.role: revision of edition with aid of Tibetan translation
relations.evidence: I earnestly entreated Dr Wogihara to revise my copy by the aid of the Tibetan translation. He was willing to undertake the task.
